title: Locally Noetherian fs realization of an affine toric chart
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring such that $Y=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is locally Noetherian [def-weil-affine-spectrum, pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $P,Q$ be fine saturated commutative monoids, written additively [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], let $g:P\to Q$ be any monoid homomorphism and let $\alpha:P\to(A,\cdot)$ be a monoid homomorphism. For a monoid $T$, write $\mathbf Z[T]$ for the ring of finite sums $\sum_t n_tz^t$, with $z^tz^{t'}=z^{t+t'}$. Use the ring maps $\mathbf Z[P]\to A$, $z^p\mapsto\alpha(p)$, and $\mathbf Z[P]\to\mathbf Z[Q]$, $z^p\mapsto z^{g(p)}$, and put $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[P]}\mathbf Z[Q]$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with multiplication $(a\otimes u)(b\otimes v)=ab\otimes uv$ and $A$-algebra map $a\mapsto a\otimes1$.

For every finite generating tuple $q_1,\ldots,q_r$ of $Q$, allowing $r=0$, evaluation $A[T_1,\ldots,T_r]\to C$, $T_i\mapsto1\otimes z^{q_i}$, is surjective [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. The ring $C$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$ is locally Noetherian. Let $\beta:Q\to C$ be $q\mapsto1\otimes z^q$. The log structure $M_X=L_X(Q,\beta)$ associated to this chart, in the notation of [lem-trf-associated-log-universal-stalks], exists and its canonical map $Q\to M_X(X)$ is a global chart whose structural image is exactly $\beta$. Thus $(X,M_X)$ is an fs log scheme. These assertions allow $C=0$ and do not require $Y$ to carry a log regular structure.

source.place: VI 1.1, printed p.69 (fs global charts and associated etale log structures); VIII 3.3.8--3.3.11, printed pp.107--108 (chart construction). Noetherian bookkeeping: Stacks algebra.tex Tag 00FN, lemma-Noetherian-permanence; properties.tex Tag 01OW, lemma-locally-Noetherian, and Tag 01OV, definition-noetherian.

proof.text: Fix any finite generating tuple q : Fin r → Q. For the polynomial evaluation ring homomorphism e, prove that every canonical monomial belongs to e.range by induction on Submonoid.closure (Set.range q): generators are images of variables, the identity is the image of 1, and products stay in the range. Induction on the monoid algebra, using monomials, addition and integer scalar multiplication, then puts every image of the right tensor inclusion in e.range. A pure tensor a ⊗ b is the product of the left inclusion of a (the image of the constant polynomial a) and the right inclusion of b. TensorProduct.induction_on, with zero and addition, proves every tensor is in e.range, hence evaluation is surjective. This argument also handles the empty generating tuple and the zero ring. The tensor and polynomial constructions are [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]; finite generation of Q is provided by [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] when selecting a tuple in the next step.

source.place: Tag 00CX, lemma-tensor-product, quotient construction and generation by pure tensors; explicit finite monoid-algebra expansion supplied by the agent.

proof.text: Apply [pqf-lem-affine-open-locnoeth] to the affine open $Y=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of itself. It makes $A$ Noetherian, using exactly the assumed local Noetherianity of $Y$. Step 1 exhibits $C$ as a finite type $A$-algebra by [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian] makes $C$ Noetherian. No injectivity of $A\to C$ or nonzero-ring assumption is among these hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 00FN, lemma-Noetherian-permanence, first sentence; properties.tex Tag 01OW, lemma-locally-Noetherian, (1) implies (2).

proof.text: The affine scheme $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$ has global ring $C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Its single affine open $X$ is therefore an affine cover with Noetherian coordinate ring by Step 2, so $X$ is locally Noetherian by [pqf-def-locnoeth]. The formula $\beta(q)=1\otimes z^q$ satisfies $\beta(0)=1$ and $\beta(q+q')=\beta(q)\beta(q')$ by the prescribed multiplication, and thus gives a monoid homomorphism into $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)=C$.

source.place: Tag 01OV, definition-noetherian, locally Noetherian clause (single affine cover); affine spectrum convention.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-associated-log-universal-stalks] to the canonical global monomial chart β on X. Use its associated-log presentation L,η and normalized pushout stalk isomorphisms e. The pair formula at the terminal etale object, with unit 1, proves α_L ∘ ι = β. To identify the stalk unit copy, represent a ring unit and its inverse on a common pointed etale neighbourhood and refine until their product equals 1, using Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective₂ and Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff'. Thus the unit has a unit-section representative. The normalized formula for e on this representative, together with the structural pair formula and the colimit germ equation, says that e([1,a]) has structural image a. Injectivity of the log-unit identification forces e([1,a]) = L.unitsIn(a). Its formula on [q,1] is the germ of the canonical chart. Multiplicativity now identifies e composed with the quotient map with the chart-times-units map on all pairs. The former is surjective and its kernel is exactly the generated pushout congruence, because e is an isomorphism. Transport the first coordinate through the canonical ULift equivalence; Con.comap_conGen_equiv identifies the resulting congruence with the one for the original monoid Q. These are precisely both clauses of IsStalkChart, hence the terminal etale object is an IsChart witness by [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. At each geometric point choose that same terminal chart and the assumed fs monoid Q, proving IsFineSaturated. No nonzero-ring or base log-regularity assumption is needed.

source.place: VI 1.1, printed p.69, etale-local fs charts; VIII 3.3.3--3.3.11, printed pp.107--108, chart realization and chart base change. Associated-log construction and stalk presentation supplied by the cited node.

lean.statement: theorem toricChart_fs_realization (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocallyNoetherian (Spec (.of A))] (P Q : Type u) [CommMonoid P] [CommMonoid Q] (_hP : IsFineSaturatedMonoid P) (_hQ : IsFineSaturatedMonoid Q) (g : P →* Q) (α : P →* A) : (∀ (r : ℕ) (q : Fin r → Q), Submonoid.closure (Set.range q) = ⊤ → Function.Surjective (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (logIdealTensorBase A α g) (fun i ↦ logIdealTensorMonomial A α g (q i)))) ∧ IsNoetherianRing (logIdealTensorRing A α g) ∧ IsLocallyNoetherian (Spec (.of (logIdealTensorRing A α g))) ∧ ∃ (L : EtaleLogStructure (Spec (.of (logIdealTensorRing A α g)))) (η : associatedLogPresheaf.{0, u} (toricTensorGlobalChart A α g) ⟶ L.monoidSheaf.obj), IsAssociatedLogPresentation.{0, u} (toricTensorGlobalChart A α g) L η ∧ L.IsChart (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of (logIdealTensorRing A α g))))) ((associatedLogIota.{0, u} (toricTensorGlobalChart A α g) L η).comp MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom) ∧ (L.alpha.app (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of (logIdealTensorRing A α g))))))).hom.comp ((associatedLogIota.{0, u} (toricTensorGlobalChart A α g) L η).comp MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom) = toricTensorGlobalChart A α g ∧ L.IsFineSaturated
